# AsterACME

> Open-source Rust ACME client and CLI: a pure protocol state machine,
> typed wire contracts, and account management that works against real
> CAs today. Certificate issuance is on the roadmap, not shipped.

## Links

- [Homepage (EN)](https://acme.astercosm.com/)
- [首页（中文）](https://acme.astercosm.com/zh/)
- [Repository](https://github.com/AsterCommunity/AsterACME)
- [Account protocol tests and staging evidence](https://github.com/AsterCommunity/AsterACME/blob/main/docs/account-testing.md)
- [Architecture design](https://github.com/AsterCommunity/AsterACME/blob/main/docs/architecture.md)
- [AsterCosmos](https://www.astercosm.com/)
